feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Trump to close and renovate D.C. golf course, despite legal battle
entry.summary: President Trump continues his efforts to remake Washington, D.C. He wants to turn an area used by the public into a world-class golf course.

entry.title: What does a White House press secretary do?
entry.summary: Katie Zacharia's short time as White House press secretary has brought renewed attention to the high-profile role.

entry.title: Ukraine and the U.S. are at odds over Starshield. Here's what to know
entry.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said he believes the U.S. government is behind his military's loss of normal access to the key satellite communications service used by the Ukrainian military.

entry.title: Noah Adams, longtime host of NPR's All Things Considered, has died
entry.summary: One of NPR's most gifted storytellers, his soft voice and vivid writing helped define the network's sound for a generation of Americans.

entry.title: Pope Leo says he will gradually resume duties after cancer surgery
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV thanked thousands of faithful in St. Peter's Square on Sunday for their prayers while he was hospitalized, and said he plans to gradually return to his usual duties.

entry.title: Trump defers federal diesel taxes to help farmers, but states issue warnings
entry.summary: President Trump's executive order deferring federal taxes on diesel is aimed at helping farmers but it's more complicated than it sounds and states are warning drivers they may owe taxes later.

entry.title: If you have the scratch, they have the scares
entry.summary: Scary stories are more than fun, they're big business.

entry.title: With an ad aimed at Trump, this Republican exposed GOP angst about Latino voters
entry.summary: Rep. María Elvira Salazar filmed an ad warning the president that he's "gone too far" on immigration. It reflected concern among some Republicans that their gains with Latino voters could be at risk.

entry.title: Carney says 4 service members killed and dozens injured in fire at Alberta military base
entry.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney described the incident as one of the worst peacetime tragedies for Canada's military on domestic soil.

entry.title: Oregon governor Tina Kotek reacts to Silver Rail Elementary school shooting
entry.summary: NPR's Joel Rose talks with Oregon Governor Tina Kotek about the shooting at Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, Oregon.
